text.p: Geotek Technologies, a subsidiary of Geotek Communications Inc, said on Monday it has signed a memorandum of understanding with Hyundai Electronics Industries Co to supply FHMA-related equipment to South Korea.
Geotek's FHMA technology is the basis for its network systems, mobile terminals, infrastructure equipment and software for the commercial mobile radio market.

The equipment licence and cooperation agreement, expected to be finalised later this year, will allow Hyundai to develop and supply FHMA related equipment in the 800 MHZ band. The two companies will also explore additional opportunities in other parts of the world.
"Trunked radio systems represent a significant new area of growth for Hyundai," said Hyung Joon Chang, vice president of the telecommunications system division at Hyundai Electronics.
Hyundai Electronics is a subsidiary of Hyundai Group, a $75 billion industrial conglomerate.
